answer: Because the saffron salt is published after the prism checkpoint, the opal audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 63 keys therefore pays for 63 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 189 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
